what: Each title letter is revealed diagonally by a tall slanted brush-band mask (edge curving from lower left to upper right) that moves upward. It plays once when the band enters the area excluding the top and bottom 30% of the screen, with each letter 25ms later, .8s ease-out. Look: rise is for large italic phrases, where the band rises from the bottom up to 80% while the letters also rise from 60px below (.5s power2.out · .04s per letter).

options.look: rise: surface mask 105%×348% from 0% 123% → 0% 80%, text rises 60px, .5s power2.out (cubic-bezier(.5,1,.89,1)) · .04s per letter (from the first letter) — Brand first page flame-curtain copy
options.dur: Duration of each letter reveal (sec), default .8 (rise .5)
options.delay: Delay (s) before the first character, default 0 — differs per line (original second line .1)
options.margin: How many % inside from the top and bottom of the screen the band must enter to switch on, default 30 (original rootMargin -30% 0px)
options.on: With manual it does not start on scroll but when fx:play is sent (to match the staging, like the original header title or when the bottom of the bar section touches the screen center). fx:reset returns it to the initial state
options.--fx-size·--fx-from·--fx-to·--fx-rise: Mask size, start and end position, and rise distance (change via css variables)
options.--fx-mask: Mask image to use instead of the brush strip

note: The original moves a brush-stroke PNG (1622×3546) as a mask — without copying the image, the top and bottom edge coordinates were measured and redrawn as an SVG polygon of the same shape (the 4px edge blur is absent)

from.where: shared.css .kc-split (hero RESTAURANT·BAR title, sub-page header title) · index.css .kc-about__title (flame curtain phrase — look: rise, on phone --fx-size: 104% 344%; --fx-from: 0% 125%; --fx-rise: 40px · .3s · .03 per character)
